def reconcile_wolf(items,archive):
    if not WOLF_CONFIG.exists(): return {'changed':False,'restarted':False,'detail':'Wolf config is not present yet'}
    image_ready=run(['docker','image','inspect',IMAGE],20).returncode==0
    blocks=[]
    if image_ready:
        blocks.append(app_block(LAUNCHER_TITLE,'PCGA-Heroic-Library','launcher',archive,LAUNCHER_SID))
        for x in items:
            token=x['pcga_set_id'].split('-',1)[1][:12]
            blocks.append(app_block(x['stream_app_title'],'PCGA-Heroic-'+token,'game',archive,x['pcga_set_id'],x['heroic_app_name'],x['heroic_runner']))
    managed=BEGIN+'\n'+('\n'.join(blocks) if blocks else '')+END+'\n'
    original=WOLF_CONFIG.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    rx=re.compile(r'(?ms)^'+re.escape(BEGIN)+r'\n.*?^'+re.escape(END)+r'\n?')
    if rx.search(original):
        updated=rx.sub(managed,original,count=1)
    else:
        # Publish into PCGA's Moonlight profile, not merely at EOF: Wolf may
        # contain more than one [[profiles]] entry and nested app arrays belong
        # to the profile section in which they are declared.
        profile_rx=re.compile(r'(?m)^\[\[profiles\]\]\s*$')
        starts=[m.start() for m in profile_rx.finditer(original)]
        insert_at=None
        for i,start in enumerate(starts):
            end=starts[i+1] if i+1<len(starts) else len(original)
            section=original[start:end]
            if re.search(r'(?m)^\s*id\s*=\s*[\"\']moonlight-profile-id[\"\']\s*$',section):
                insert_at=end; break
        if insert_at is None:
            raise RuntimeError('Wolf moonlight-profile-id profile is missing')
        updated=original[:insert_at].rstrip()+'\n\n'+managed+'\n'+original[insert_at:].lstrip('\n')
    if updated==original: return {'changed':False,'restarted':False,'detail':'Wolf Heroic applications are current'}
    # Validate TOML before replacing the authoritative Wolf config.
    try:
        import tomllib; tomllib.loads(updated)
    except Exception as exc: raise RuntimeError(f'generated Wolf TOML is invalid: {exc}')
    backup=WOLF_CONFIG.with_suffix('.toml.pre-heroic')
    if not backup.exists(): shutil.copy2(WOLF_CONFIG,backup)
    tmp=WOLF_CONFIG.with_suffix('.toml.heroic.tmp'); tmp.write_text(updated); os.replace(tmp,WOLF_CONFIG)
    if runtime_active():
        atomic_json(STATE/'wolf-reload-pending.json',{'schema':1,'reason':'heroic-catalog-changed','updated_at':time.time()})
        return {'changed':True,'restarted':False,'pending':True,'detail':'Heroic catalog updated; Wolf reload deferred until active game sessions finish'}
    p=run(['docker','restart','wolf'],90)
    restarted=p.returncode==0
    if restarted:
        (STATE/'wolf-reload-pending.json').unlink(missing_ok=True)
        bootstrap=Path('/usr/local/sbin/pcga-moonlight-web-bootstrap')
        if bootstrap.exists(): run([str(bootstrap)],180)
    return {'changed':True,'restarted':restarted,'detail':'Heroic Wolf applications published' if restarted else ('Wolf config updated; restart failed: '+(p.stderr or p.stdout)[-500:])}
